text:
carol: Deploybot failed publishing image for release 1.12.0 to eu-west-1 ECR — provenance attestation was rejected. Logs below, can someone triage?

carol: ```
[2026-03-21T12:02:43Z] publish: redwood/api:1.12.0 -> eu-west-1
error: provenance attestation: NOT_FOUND (cosign verification failed)
deploybot: publish aborted
```

deploybot: automated: publish failed for `redwood/api:1.12.0` (retry 1). Error: PROVENANCE_ATTESTATION_MISSING. See https://deploybot.internal/jobs/98321 for details.

alice: ty. do we have the last-good digest for canary in eu? if so we can pin to that while infra fixes cosign.

ben: we can retag the last good digest as `1.12.0-manual-republish` and push to eu. but retagging will need a release note + canary hold. :thinking_face:

dave: what happens if we just skip provenance checks for eu temporarily? is that allowed for any customers?

erin: legal/compliance flagged eu attestation as required for some regulated customers. skipping is not an option for those customers. we need a controlled manual republish with audit metadata.

infra-bot: ECR eu-west-1 replication: healthy. cosign-verifier service: 500 on POST /verify since 12:03 UTC.
`curl -sS https://cosign.internal/verify -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null -> 500`

carol: proposal: hold the canary rollout in EU. fallback plan: pin to previous digest `sha256:abc123def4567890` in the canary config so we don't promote a broken publish, and do a manual republish to eu after cosign is healthy. who can do the retag + PR?

ben: i can do the retag + PR. will add explicit labels for audit and update release notes: "EU republish pending provenance".

alice: assign @ben. also set deploybot region skip for eu (`region_skip=eu-west-1`) for the 1.12.0 canary. include expected ETA in notes.

dave: what's the timeline? infra estimate to fix cosign?

infra-bot: investigating: cosign failing due to rotated KMS key not present in verifier truststore. KMS team notified, estimated 45-60m to restore.

erin: security already notified. they require audit log entries for any manual retag/republish. Ben, please include `manual_republisher` and `manual_republish_reason` in image labels.

ben: ack. PR will include labels: `manual_republish=true`, `manual_republisher=ben`, `manual_republish_reason=prov-missing-eu`. i'll also mention timeline and which clusters to target. starting retag now.

carol: canary hold in place. i've posted a note to #release-notes and paged the release manager. @sre-ops please standby for smoke tests after republish.

sre-ops: standing by. once republish is done we'll run: `smoke/regression --region eu-west-1 --image sha256:abc123def4567890` and validate latency + basic flows.

deploybot: automated: stopping further publish attempts to eu-west-1 for 1.12.0 while `region_override=eu-west-1` is set.

carol: action items summary: Ben -> retag + PR + changelog entry (ETA 20m). Infra/KMS -> fix cosign (ETA 45m). SRE -> smoke after republish. If cosign not resolved in 60m, rollback EU production to 1.11.9 (decision owner: carol). I'll update the canary window accordingly.

ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4287 — includes labels, changelog entry, and instructions for manual republish. kicking off the push now.

carol: ack. filing postmortem tag `prov-eu-3169991111`. will close thread once republish + smoke pass. thanks everyone!"
